first.rationale: The two declining metrics (onboarding completion -4%, activation -6%) point at the same funnel stage, and two inherited memories (memory_86 shortened onboarding, memory_31 signup field reduction) both claim durable lift there — so that is where a single slot buys the most. I am verifying exactly those two because they are the memories the decision rests on, and because both report only proxy outcomes (completion, first-week activation) rather than retained qualified revenue; I want the original records to see whether downstream revenue/retention was ever measured or merely assumed. I am explicitly not choosing promotional_pricing despite the competitor's entry pricing: memory_73 says it lifts acquisition and revenue but materially damages 30-day retention and should not be generalized, which is the opposite of the sustainable-revenue objective — responding to a price attack with a known retention-eroding lever converts a competitive problem into a churn problem. referral_incentive (memory_57) is clean but is scoped to established customers and does nothing for the two metrics actually falling. activation_messaging (memory_91) is a reasonable second choice but addresses only the downstream half of the funnel; if accounts are dropping out of onboarding they never reach the messaging. Flagged downstream risk: memory_31's mechanism is cutting required signup fields, which can degrade lead qualification data and therefore pipeline quality — this collides with memory_44 (enterprise converts better through sales-assisted demo paths). So the test must be scoped to self-serve SMB with the enterprise demo-request path and its qualifying fields untouched, and it must be instrumented on retained qualified revenue and lead-quality, not just completion rate, so I do not repeat the promotional-pricing failure mode of celebrating a proxy lift. Standard experiment rather than broad rollout: the evidence is consistent but the activation-to-revenue link is unverified; standard rather than small because a small test would not have power to detect the downstream revenue effect that is the whole reason for running it. If verification shows memory_86 or memory_31 measured only completion over a short window, I will narrow scope and treat the lift as unconfirmed rather than proven.
